classical_reading: Lashuna is tikshna, ushna and V-2 — the great Vatahara, used in Gulma and Anaha, and one of the few dravyas named for exactly this complaint.
modern_reading: Garlic is a fructan and one of the two canonical high-FODMAP triggers for bloating; it is the first thing a modern elimination diet removes.

classical_reading: Palandu is V-1 and Vatahara cooked; classically it is not restricted in Adhmana.
modern_reading: Onion is the other canonical high-FODMAP trigger, and raw onion is reported as a bloating trigger more often than any other vegetable.

classical_reading: Godhuma is guru and sthira but V-2, and wheat roti is the staple anna; classical Anaha Apathya names the Shimbi varga, not wheat.
modern_reading: Wheat is a fructan source and is restricted alongside garlic and onion in a FODMAP protocol.
